descriptions.w3d_cc25b_sample_weighted_80195adc: Returns observed failure status when the channel range is empty; otherwise fills the output range from the original float object, samples tracks whose weight has nonzero raw bits with the original fused time expression and first-track flag, optionally postprocesses, then emits grouped values. The raw-bit guard intentionally includes negative zero and NaNs. Semantic names are inferred.
